title: Clan Saxon Gauntlet
text:
Sentinel (Units in this arena can't attack your non-Sentinel units or your base.)
When this unit is attacked: You may give an Experience token to a unit (before damage is dealt).
rules:
When this unit is attacked” triggers at the same time as “On Attack” abilities.
On Defense abilities trigger when this unit is chosen as the defender for an attack, in the same window as the attacker's On Attack abilities. / updated templating
